name: Feet in Straps — Frogs & Circles
summary: Feet in the straps for frogs, circles and openings. Works the inner thighs and back of the legs while the pelvis stays still.

cautions.note: Limit hip rotation and range as advised by the client's surgeon or physio.

review.note: Starter entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
